title: NAIST COVID: Multilingual COVID-19 Twitter and Weibo Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a multilingual social media dataset concerning the COVID-19 pandemic and performs initial quantitative and qualitative analyses. It does not engage with topics of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The paper's ethical component is restricted to adhering to the terms of service of the data sources by publishing tweet/post IDs instead of full content, which is a standard procedure for data sharing and not a core research focus on ethics.
